text.en:
All laws, orders, rules and regulations inconsistent
with this Executive Order are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.
This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 17th day of June, in the
year of Our lord, nineteen hundred and eighty-seven.
By the President:
ecutive Secretary
